decks.summary: Blurse-juggling flex Kōhaku who adds curses with Gabriel Carillo and Faustian Bargain, stores them on Favor of the Moon, and cashes them in through Armageddon and The Key of Solomon; the guide covers every role.
Hard and Expert solo Kōhaku reaching 10+ skill values with Read the Signs, Spectral Razor and Fey while Favor of the Sun and Moon, Blasphemous Covenant and Eye of the Djinn exploit the blurse.
Eye of Chaos Kōhaku who squeezes two resources, a card and two clues out of each investigation through Blasphemous Covenant, Fey and The Key of Solomon.
Two-box Hemlock Vale Kōhaku who recycles Absolution and Drain Essence through Book of Living Myths, backed by Shrivelling, Wicked Athame and Drawn to the Flame.
Spanish-podcast bless Kōhaku with Spirit of Humanity, Favor of the Sun and Holy Rosary, investigating with Sixth Sense and Read the Signs.
Spanish-podcast curse Kōhaku who piles curses on Favor of the Moon and spends them through Armageddon (4), Dawn Star and Rod of Carnamagos, with Prismatic Spectacles for clues.
Theorycrafted blursed folklorist Kōhaku with Eye of Chaos and Wicked Athame, Flashlight for clues, and Paradoxical Covenant rewarding the mix of bless and curse.
Thematic blursed Kōhaku with Armageddon and Eye of Chaos, Olive McBride and Dark Prophecy to pick tokens, and Paradoxical Covenant and Rite of Sanctification balancing the bag.
Curse Kōhaku who turns curses into blesses for his teammates with Tides of Fate, fights with Armageddon and Spectral Razor, and investigates with Read the Signs.
Level 0 Kōhaku with Shrivelling and Storm of Spirits, Drawn to the Flame for clues, and Rod of Carnamagos and Control Variable; the guide is a short upgrade list.
